scripts.text:
[Airship Crew]
If we've landed at
your destination and
you'd like to leave the
Airship, please use the
stairs up ahead. Thank
you for your patronage.
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇船员]
如果飞空艇已抵达您的目的地，而您想下船，请走前方的楼梯。
感谢您的搭乘。

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Makumalagu!
Saampa joojimbo
kaku na jedi Solo.
Bwahahahahahahaah!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
Makumalagu!
Saampa joojimbo
kaku na jedi Solo.
Bwahahahahahahaah!

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Wow, mom!
L-look at this!
We're flying! W-we're...
We're in the freakin' sky!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
哇，妈妈！
快...快看！
我们飞起来了！我...我们...
我们真的飞到天上了！

scripts.text:
[Lady]
Chooktu!
Sacraup matii!
Shaka gurftalfi
huntiki manjoo!
scripts.translation:
[女士]
Chooktu!
Sacraup matii!
Shaka gurftalfi
huntiki manjoo!

scripts.text:
[Lady]
Shush...
Honey, behave~
Don't act so excited
when we're out in a
public place like this!
scripts.translation:
[女士]
嘘...
宝贝，乖一点~
在这种公共场合，别这么兴奋！

scripts.text:
[Chrmlim]
Hey there~
From that look on
your face, I see that
you can understand
me. ^333333*Whew...!*^000000
scripts.translation:
[查姆林]
你好~
看你的表情，我就知道你听得懂我说的话。
^333333*呼...！*^000000

scripts.text:
[Chrmlim]
I've been helping the
Airship enterprise by
having the Airship Crewmen
train in Umbala to overcome
any acrophobia they might have through bungee jumping. Neat, eh?
scripts.translation:
[查姆林]
我一直在帮飞空艇公司训练船员，让他们到汶巴拉练习蹦极，以克服恐高症。
很棒吧？

scripts.text:
[Chrmlim]
But...
Some of them couldn't
overcome their fear of
heights. And a few even
ended up, um, ^333333in Niflheim^000000.
scripts.translation:
[查姆林]
不过...
有些人还是克服不了恐高症。
甚至有几个人最后...嗯，去了^333333尼弗海姆^000000。

scripts.text:
[Chrmlim]
Bajoo ga
nukta Airship.
scripts.translation:
[查姆林]
Bajoo ga
nukta Airship.

scripts.text:
[Chrmlim]
Shabala moow bajama
Airship kulaha googoona 
salu. Dama, kookoo na nu
yukuta. Um, fashuku na ret!
scripts.translation:
[查姆林]
Shabala moow bajama
Airship kulaha googoona 
salu. Dama, kookoo na nu
yukuta. Um, fashuku na ret!

scripts.text:
[Airship Staff]
Welcome
to the Airship.
How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工作人员]
欢迎乘坐飞空艇。
您需要什么服务呢？

scripts.text: Do you have a passenger named Thierry?
scripts.translation: 有位叫蒂埃里的乘客吗？

scripts.text:
[Airship Staff]
I am sorry, but I do not think that we have a passenger by that name.
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工作人员]
很抱歉，我想我们这里没有叫这个名字的乘客。

scripts.text:
[Airship Staff]
Welcome
to the Airship.
How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工作人员]
欢迎乘坐飞空艇。
您需要什么服务呢？

scripts.text: Using the Airship
scripts.translation: 乘坐须知

scripts.text: Captain's Cabin
scripts.translation: 船长室

scripts.text: Facilities
scripts.translation: 设施

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Airship Staff]
When you see a broadcast
announcing that we have
arrived at your destination,
please use one of the exits
located at the north and
south ends of the Airship.
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工作人员]
听到广播通知您已抵达目的地后，请从飞空艇北端或南端的出口下船。

scripts.text:
[Airship Staff]
If you happen to miss
your stop, don't worry.
The Airship is constantly
en route and you'll get
another chance to arrive
to your intended destination.
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工作人员]
如果不小心坐过站，也不用担心。
飞空艇会继续航行，之后还会再次抵达您的目的地。

scripts.text:
[Airship Staff]
The Captain's Cabin
is located at the front
of the Airship. There, you
can meet the captain and
the pilot of the Airship.
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工作人员]
船长室位于飞空艇前部。
您可以在那里见到船长和飞行员。

scripts.text:
[Airship Staff]
The Airship provides
various Mini Games for
the entertainment of all
our passengers. We invite
you to try your luck and skills
in the Airship's Mini Games~
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工作人员]
飞空艇为各位乘客准备了各种小游戏。
欢迎来试试运气、一展身手~

scripts.text:
[Airship Staff]
Well, I hope you
your flight aboard
our Airships. Thank
you and have a good day.
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工作人员]
希望您在飞空艇上度过一段愉快的旅程。
谢谢，祝您今天愉快。

scripts.text:
[Zerta]
Oh, hello adventurer.
I am currently on a
sacred journey, offering
prayer for the sake of the
Midgard continent.
scripts.translation:
[泽塔]
啊，你好，冒险者。
我正在踏上一段神圣的旅程，为米德加尔特大陆祈祷。

scripts.text:
[Maelin]
Um, this Airship is
to Lutie, isn't it? I've
waiting so long,
but I haven't heard any
broadcast about Lutie.
scripts.translation:
[梅琳]
嗯，这艘飞空艇是开往姜饼城的吧？
我等了好久，却一直没听到姜饼城即将抵达的广播。

scripts.text:
[Aanos]
Oh wooow~
The sky looks
so different and
pretty from up there!
scripts.translation:
[阿诺斯]
哇哦~
从高空看出去，天空真特别，也真漂亮啊！

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
I wish that I could go drink a cold fresh beer.
Drinking is the goal of my life! Drinking gives me energy!
I am nothing without drinks!
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
真想去喝杯冰镇鲜啤酒啊。
喝酒就是我的人生目标！喝酒让我浑身是劲！
没了酒，我可就什么都不是了！

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
But! Driving under the influence is not good.
But! That makes me want to drink more and more!
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
可是！酒后驾驶可不行。
可越是这样，我就越想喝酒！

scripts.text: Do you know a passenger named Thierry?
scripts.translation: 你认识一位名叫蒂埃里的乘客吗？

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
This uniform is
really dapper, but
it's way too thick to
wear around the Airship.
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
这身制服是挺帅，可在飞空艇上穿，实在太厚了。

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
...
......
No one ever really
comes into this room.
And the captain IS a reindeer. I could just strip to my boxers.
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
...
......
反正也没什么人会进这间屋子。
而且船长还是只驯鹿，我干脆脱得只剩条内裤好了。

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
Wah!? Who is it!
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
哇！？谁啊！

scripts.text: - ...He is not listening to you, at all. -
scripts.translation: - ...他完全没在听你说话。-

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
It's been sooo
long since I've
enjoyed a nice, cold
alcoholic brew. But the
job requires me to be as
clear headed as I can!
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
我已经好久好久没喝上一杯冰凉的好酒了。
可这份工作要求我时刻保持清醒！

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
Always drink responsibly!
Still, I can't remember the
last time I had a real vacation
or even a day off. Yeap, some
booze, some chips, some TV
and serious R&R is in order.
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
喝酒一定要有节制！
不过，我都不记得上次好好休假是什么时候了，哪怕只休一天也好。
是啊，我该喝点酒、吃点薯片、看看电视，彻底放松一下了。

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
Man, the weather
is really nice today.
Bright, open skies make
for some good visibility
and safe, carefree flying.
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
今天天气真不错。
天空晴朗开阔，能见度很好，飞起来既安全又轻松。

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
You know, our captain's a
respectable guy. Him and
his brother are actually well
known in the aircraft industry.
Who knew reindeer made
such good captains?
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
你知道吗？我们的船长很受人尊敬。
他和他的兄弟在航空业都很有名。
谁能想到驯鹿也能当这么出色的船长呢？

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
Just between you
and me, I gotta tell
you, that Santa was onto
something, getting reindeers
and elves to work for him.
The man must be a genius!
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
悄悄告诉你，圣诞老人让驯鹿和精灵为他干活，这主意还真不错。
他一定是个天才！

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
You know, this whole
piloting thing in the air,
it's rather new, you know?
Yeah, they got this Airship
operation in a hurry.
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
你知道吗？驾驶飞空艇在空中飞行还是件新鲜事呢。
没错，他们很快就着手运营飞空艇了。

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
Still, they were real
serious, really thought
ahead. I mean, they had us
training while the Airships
were still being invented.
Isn't that freakin' crazy?!
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
不过，他们办事很认真，也很有远见。
飞空艇还在研发时，就已经开始训练我们了。
是不是很疯狂？！

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
Welcome to Fruitz's
Shop where you can
purchase Apples or grind
them to make Apple Juice.
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
欢迎光临我的店！这里可以买苹果，也可以把苹果榨成苹果汁。

scripts.text: Buy Apples.
scripts.translation: 购买苹果

scripts.text: Make Apple Juice.
scripts.translation: 制作苹果汁

scripts.text: Why are you here?
scripts.translation: 你来这里做什么？

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
Please enter the amount
of Apples that you wish to
buy. Each Apple is 15 zeny
and you can buy a maximum
of 500 at a time. Please enter
 '0' to cancel your order.
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
请输入要购买的苹果数量。
每个苹果15 Zeny，每次最多可买500个。
输入“0”取消购买。

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
Thanks for stopping
by my shop. Farewell!
Come by anytime when
you feel like having an
Apple to snack on~
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
感谢光临我的小店，再见！
想吃苹果时，随时欢迎再来哦~

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
You've entered a number
higher than the maximum
value of 500. Please enter
the number of Apples you
wish to purchase again.
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
您输入的数量超过了上限500。
请重新输入要购买的苹果数量。

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
A total of ^FF0000{0}^000000 Apples
will cost you ^FF0000{1}^000000 zeny.
Would you like to continue?
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
购买^FF0000{0}^000000个苹果，共需^FF0000{1}^000000 Zeny。
您要继续购买吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
Thanks for stopping
by my shop. Farewell!
Come by anytime when
you feel like having an
Apple to snack on~
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
感谢光临我的小店，再见！
想吃苹果时，随时欢迎再来哦~

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
I'm sorry, but you don't
have enough money to
purchase that many Apples.
Please check your zeny or
purchase fewer Apples.
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
很抱歉，您的Zeny不够，买不了这么多苹果。
请确认Zeny余额，或减少购买数量。

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
Hmmm, I don't think
you've got enough room in
your inventory to carry this
many Apples. Why don't you free up some of your inventory space?
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
嗯，您的背包空间恐怕不够，装不下这么多苹果。
要不要先腾出些空间？

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
Thanks for stopping by
my shop. I hope you enjoy
the flavor of these Apples~!
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
感谢光临我的小店。
希望您喜欢这些苹果的味道~！

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
Okay, I'll need
^FF00003 Apples and 1 Empty Bottle^000000
to make 1 Apple Juice for you.
Would you like to proceed?
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
好的，制作1瓶苹果汁需要^FF00003个苹果和1个空瓶^000000。
您要继续吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
I'm sorry, but you don't
have enough materials to
create a bottle of Apple Juice.
Remember, I need 3 Apples
and 1 Empty Bottle to do it.
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
很抱歉，您的材料不足，无法制作苹果汁。
制作1瓶苹果汁需要3个苹果和1个空瓶。

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
Thank you,
please wait
just a moment.
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
谢谢，请稍等片刻。

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Grind grind*
*Grind grind*
*Clang...!*^000000

[Fruitz]
There you go~
I hope you enjoy!
Please feel free to
stop by for your Apple
and Apple Juice needs
at anytime, adventurer~
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
给您~
希望您喜欢！
冒险者，以后想买苹果或苹果汁，随时欢迎来找我~

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
Thanks for stopping
by my shop. Farewell!
Come by anytime when
you feel like having an
Apple to snack on~
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
感谢光临我的小店，再见！
想吃苹果时，随时欢迎再来哦~

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
I used to be a wandering
vagabond when, one day,
I took a nap and something
struck my head and awoke
me from my restful slumber.
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
我以前四处流浪。有一天，我正在打盹，忽然有什么东西砸中我的脑袋，把我惊醒了。

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
It turns out that I was
sleeping beneath an apple
tree and that an apple fell
and hit me on the head.
I was dying of hunger and
was about to eat that Apple...
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
原来我睡在一棵苹果树下，一颗苹果掉下来砸中了我的脑袋。
我当时饿得要命，正准备把那颗苹果吃掉...

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
But suddenly, Kain, my old
friend from the mining days,
asked me to help him around
on the Airship. So I did, and
it was there where I found some
people playing the Dice game.
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
就在这时，我以前在矿山结识的老朋友凯恩请我去飞空艇上帮忙。我答应了。
在那里，我看到有人在玩骰子。

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
I was bored and curious
and ended up wagering that
single Apple in a game of
dice. But for some reason,
I had this incredible lucky
streak. One apple became two...
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
我闲着无聊，又有些好奇，就拿仅有的那颗苹果玩骰子下注。
没想到运气出奇地好，一路赢了下去。
一颗苹果变成了两颗...

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
Two became four and
before I knew it, I had
cornered the Apple market!
I won so many Apples, I just
started my own business here
on the Airship. Weird, huh?
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
两颗变成四颗，不知不觉间，我竟然垄断了苹果市场！
赢来的苹果实在太多，我干脆就在飞空艇上开了家苹果店。
很奇怪吧？

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
So Apples are good
for you. They were
certainly very good
to me. Hahahahaah~!
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
所以说，苹果对身体有好处。
对我来说，苹果当然也好处多多。
哈哈哈哈~！

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
Thank you for
using my shop.
Farewell~
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
感谢您光顾我的小店。
再见~

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
Longitude, 131 degrees east.
Latitude, 37 degrees north.
We're right on course, captain.
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
东经131度，北纬37度。
我们正沿航线飞行，船长。

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
Looks like a really
cloudy day. Always hard
to navigate when the skies
aren't clear. Guess we'll
need to amp the radar.
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
今天云层真厚。
天空不晴朗，导航就很费劲。
看来得增强雷达功率了。

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
The Captain is a good
man and I can't think of
a finer person to command
this ship. Still, he's pretty
tough, a real slave driver.
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
船长人不错，我想不出还有谁比他更适合指挥这艘飞空艇。
不过，他确实挺严厉的，简直把我们当苦力使唤。

scripts.text:
[^ff0000Tarlock^000000]
^ff0000Hey...!^000000
^ff0000Less chit-chat^000000
^ff0000and more piloting!^000000

[Pilot]
R-right away, sir!
(See what I mean?)
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
是...是，长官！
（你看，我没说错吧？）

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
This uniform is
really dapper, but
it's way too thick to
wear around the Airship.
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
这身制服是挺帅，可在飞空艇上穿，实在太厚了。

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
...
......
No one ever really
comes into this room.
And the captain IS a reindeer.
I could just strip to my boxers.
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
...
......
反正也没什么人会进这间屋子。
而且船长还是只驯鹿，我干脆脱得只剩条内裤好了。

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
Oh...! Hello there!
E-e-enjoying your flight?!
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
哦...！你好！
这...这趟飞行还愉快吗？！

scripts.text:
[Dianne]
It's so weird!
I went to visit the
Airship Captain and
all I saw was this
weird reindeer. Oh!
Do you think that...
scripts.translation:
[黛安]
太奇怪了！
我去拜访飞空艇船长，结果只看到一只奇怪的驯鹿。
哦！你说会不会...

scripts.text:
[Mendel]
As I expected, the
in-flight meals are
three star quality at best.
*Harrrumph* I really should
have brought my chef so that
I could enjoy a real meal.
scripts.translation:
[门德尔]
果然不出我所料，机上餐食顶多算得上三星水准。
*哼* 我真该把自家厨师带来，这样才能吃顿像样的饭。

scripts.text:
[Swordsman Shimizu]
Finally, after five
years of waiting...
I can have my revenge!
scripts.translation:
[剑士 清水]
等了五年...终于可以报仇了！

scripts.text:
[Swordsman Shimizu]
I just...
Have to make sure that
I don't keep missing my
stop. But soon, very soon,
vengeance will be mine!
scripts.translation:
[剑士 清水]
我只要...别再坐过站就好。
不过很快，很快，我就能报仇了！

scripts.text:
[Clarice]
Hi, I'm Clarice~
How would you like
to wager some Apples
in a friendly game of Dice?
scripts.translation:
[克拉丽丝]
嗨，我是克拉丽丝~
要不要用苹果下注，和我玩一局骰子？

scripts.text: Play Dice Game
scripts.translation: 玩骰子游戏

scripts.text: Learn Dice Game Rules
scripts.translation: 了解骰子游戏规则

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Clarice]
The rules for the Dice game
are pretty simple. First, you
place a bet by wagering Apples.
You can bet a maximum of 50
Apples at a time. To keep things
legal, I can only accept Apples.
scripts.translation:
[克拉丽丝]
骰子游戏的规则很简单。先用苹果下注，每次最多押50个。
为了遵守规定，我只收苹果。

scripts.text:
[Clarice]
Ooh, so you'll play with
me? Great! How many
Apples would you like to bet?
Remember, you can wager
up to 50 Apples. If you'd like
to cancel, please enter '0'.
scripts.translation:
[克拉丽丝]
哦，你要和我玩？
太好了！想押多少个苹果？
最多可以押50个，输入“0”就取消。

scripts.text:
[Clarice]
But hey, if all that zeny
is burning a hole in your
pocket, head over to Fruitz
and you can buy as many
Apples as you want, playah~
scripts.translation:
[克拉丽丝]
不过，要是你口袋里的Zeny多得烫手，就去找弗鲁茨买苹果吧。
想买多少都行，伙计~

scripts.text:
[Clarice]
So you'll be
betting ^FF0000{0}^000000 Apples.
Is that right?
scripts.translation:
[克拉丽丝]
你这次要押^FF0000{0}^000000个苹果，对吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:

50 Apples. Remember, we
need to keep these stakes
reasonable. Please enter
a value no greater than 50.
scripts.translation:
[克拉丽丝]
每次最多只能押50个苹果，赌注要适度。
请输入不超过50的数量。

scripts.text:
[Clarice]

rolling two 6-sided dice.
When it's your turn, you'll
roll two 6-sided dice. After
that, both of us will have the
option of rolling a third die.
scripts.translation:
[克拉丽丝]

之后，我们都可以选择是否再掷第三颗。

number of Apples you
wish to place in this bet

thing. If your total is higher
than 12, you'll bust, meaning
that you lose. Otherwise, the
person with the higher total
is the winner. Got it?
